soundness_flags.label: prop:all-valid-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: For p>1 with heterogeneous covariance blocks, M is a sum of rational terms whose cleared boundary equation can have degree 2p, not Fieller quadratic inversion; restrict the Fieller claim to p=1 and call the general case AR-type rational inversion.

soundness_flags.label: ass:block-independence and ass:known-covariance
soundness_flags.one_line: The Wang--Kang citation uses estimated covariance matrices and permits correlated instruments, while Fieller treats estimated variance/covariance; neither supports these exact known-covariance mutually independent blocks as the named standard conditions.

soundness_flags.label: ass:local-gaussian-scaling
soundness_flags.one_line: Wang--Kang assumes convergence of scaled estimated covariance matrices, not the exact triangular identity Omega_j=Sigma_j/n; retag this as the proposal's exact Gaussian subexperiment.

soundness_flags.label: ass:simple-separated-faces
soundness_flags.one_line: Fang--Santos studies directional differentiability and bootstrap validity, not this pairwise BudgetIV endpoint no-tie condition; retag it as a model-specific regular-face condition and justify its genericity.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:whole-set-coverage and thm:complete-inversion
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact finite-sample validity is conditional on fixed p,K, mutually independent Gaussian blocks with known positive-definite covariance; it is not an exact GWAS guarantee with estimated covariance or residual LD.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The whole-set coverage and topology-certificate headline is conditional on the stated exact Gaussian summary experiment.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:complete-inversion
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Bit-level termination uses rational or real-algebraic inputs and either an exact-real sign oracle for q or the conservative rational cutoff q-plus.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The exact-q output is oracle-relative; the unconditional terminating arithmetic certificate is for the enlarged C_alpha-plus complex.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:regular-endpoint-limit
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Endpoint and label recovery excludes zero first stages, tangencies, shrinking gaps, exchange ties, and singleton/nonregular components.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The joint endpoint limit is conditional on separated positive-width regular faces.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6–7, Section 4.1 and Theorem 4; p. 9, Section 7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings version uses NOME, gives asymptotic coverage through a Bonferroni box for beta_y, and explicitly says finite-sample uncertainty without NOME remains open.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 2.1, Assumptions 1–4, especially lines 94–104; Section 2.2, Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes independent exposure/outcome summary vectors, Gaussian vector summaries, and estimated covariance matrices converging to true covariances; it does not assume known covariance or independent instrument blocks.

Fieller studies roots of a simple ratio equation with normally distributed estimates and jointly estimated variance/covariance quantities; its canonical quadratic classification is scalar-ratio geometry.
The paper provides analytic projection-based AR confidence sets and a necessary-and-sufficient boundedness condition for the ordinary quadric setting.
The preprint develops root-based exact inversion for AR and LM rational-polynomial statistics and controlled approximations for broader tests, motivated by grid omissions.
VIPER's validification gives strong pointwise validity and confidence-set coverage for the true beta when the violation set contains the true alpha.
The article concerns inference and bootstrap validity for directionally differentiable maps; it does not formulate the proposal's pairwise simple-root/no-tie BudgetIV endpoint condition.
